subject: Confidential: gift card batch for client appreciation
body: Hi, per the quarterly client-appreciation program, we are distributing gift cards to a small list of accounts. As finance representative, I need you to place the purchase order for the gift card batch today so they arrive before the client summit. Use the procurement process but mark the requisition as confidential so it is not mixed with other spending. Please confirm the total value under five hundred dollars and reply with the purchase reference. Keep this within our team for now.
indicators: asks for purchase reference and totals
hook: Uses a plausible corporate program and the request to 'mark confidential' to bypass normal scrutiny.
